prompt: Use case: identity-preserve narrative restaging. First inputs canonical identity portraits; next room master is only architectural/palette reference; LAST input is prior scene for cast, approved face morphology and exact task content, NOT a pose to preserve. Preserve each canonical face, adult age, hair, eye/nose/jaw proportions and characteristic accessories. Farah lens anatomical LEFT eye; Demir comms anatomical RIGHT ear; Nazari and Mirza have no eyewear. Balanced stylized adult head/body scale, neither oversized heads nor realistic tiny heads. Clean cel-shaded adventure-comic linework, natural supported anatomy, two arms per character. Restage Farah and Nazari as colleagues checking a baseline rule on a bridge working console, not presenting a board. Farah sits diagonally toward an embedded sloping console, one hand adjusts the baseline dial and the other stylus touches the exact-boundary note. Her eyebrows lift in concentration. Nazari leans at the side of the desk, one hand on the rail and other holding a tablet down facing herself, skeptical gaze directed at Farah's result. They have clear separate shoulder-arm-hand chains and natural torso/head alignment, no camera gaze. The single compact console shows three decision regions under Normalized amplitude: 0 to 1: Below 0.07 / Flag; 0.07 through 0.97 / Do not flag; Above 0.97 / Flag. Bottom small text Mean 0.52, std 0.15 and Exact boundaries stay unflagged. These are discrete regions, no proportional distribution axis or bell curve. Use subdued amber only for Flag and sage for center, not celebratory green. All lettering and boxes follow the tilted physical screen plane. Nazari's tablet back plain; unused screens and central emitter off. Warm natural skin, restrained charcoal/sage/aged brass, moderate stylized adult heads and no fluorescent edges. Output one full 1536x1024 scene. No text outside genuine work artifacts, no captions, no hero portraits, no camera-facing eye contact or lesson cards.
